title: Braised Carrots with Ginger and Garlic
blurb: Tender carrots simmered in a savoury ginger and garlic sauce, finished with fresh coriander.
steps: Peel the carrots and cut them into thick batons about 5cm long and 1cm wide. Peel and finely chop the ginger and garlic.
Heat the vegetable oil in a wide pan over medium heat and add the ginger and garlic. Fry for one minute until fragrant.
Add the carrots to the pan and stir to coat them in the ginger and garlic. Pour in the soy sauce and water, then bring to a simmer.
Cover the pan and cook for 25 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the carrots are tender when pierced with a knife.
Mix the cornflour with two tablespoons of cold water to make a smooth paste. Stir this into the pan and simmer for two minutes until the sauce thickens.
Remove from the heat and stir in the sesame oil. Slice the spring onions and roughly chop the coriander, then scatter both over the carrots before serving.
